decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed height and design of the proposal would be detrimental to the appearance of the street scene and the proposal would lead to a significant loss of privacy to the occupiers of the surrounding residential properties. This would be contrary to Policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and Policies ENV-B.1.1, H.6.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001).

Condition : 2 - The proposal would result in the loss of parking in connection with the mini-cab business to the front and the garage space would not have pedestrian visibility splays. The proposal would thereby be detrimental to pedestrian and highway safety contrary to policies T.2.5 and T.3.6 of the Adopted Unitary Development Plan (1996) and policies T 1.4 and T.4.4 of the Proposed Alterations Revised Deposit Unitary Development Plan (2001)
description: Erection of a detached one bedroom dwellinghouse with integral garage.
